target.name: WISE J085510.83-071442.5
target.notes: Coldest known Y dwarf (~250 K) at 2.28 pc. Challenge prompt coordinates (~133.795, -7.245) are from ~2010 discovery epoch; today it lies ~20 SPHEREx pixels West at RA ~133.760, Dec ~-7.2422. Only detectable at lambda > 3.9 um (SPHEREx Bands 5 and 6). Beware stationary background source 29 arcsec from the 2010 discovery coordinate.

scientific_warnings: 180-degree spacecraft roll (SPS_EPA) flip detected across survey passes; all frames have been WCS-reprojected onto a common North-up, East-left TAN grid.

SPHEREx Linear Variable Filters sample a different wavelength per exposure. Compare brightness strictly within the same detector band to distinguish true variability from the star's spectral energy distribution (SED).
Detector core saturation (OVERFLOW / NaN core) detected in 1/3 frames. Visual cores are reconstructed from the 98th-percentile PSF halo; astrometric centroids use halo center-of-mass.
WISE 0855-0714 (~250 K Y dwarf) is only detectable at lambda > 3.9 um (SPHEREx Bands 5 and 6) and lies ~20 pixels West of its 2010 discovery coordinate.
